answer: Bindings are kept in falcon, verified in whisper, and the chain is public. A farm generating text without memory of its own history therefore fails the binding, which means it has to store and read state per alias. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 5 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the crystal check. Every extra alias adds 3 hours of verification and 24 percent more locked value. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
